cohort: The study included records of 1011 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of Alexandria University Maternity Hospital.
finding: Necrotizing enterocolitis, early onset sepsis, and late onset sepsis were identified as the main determinants of neonatal thrombocytopenia, while severe intraventricular hemorrhage, pulmonary hemorrhage, and cardiovascular instability were primary predictors of death in thrombocytopenic patients.
birth_weight: Birthweight was significantly lower in the thrombocytopenic group.
gest_age: Gestational age was significantly lower in the thrombocytopenic group.
